meta.name: vercel-cli
meta.description: Deploy apps to Vercel. Use when asked to deploy, ship, or publish a web application, or manage Vercel projects, domains, and environment variables.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把网页应用发布到 Vercel，管理域名和环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你经常要把网站部署到 Vercel 并管理其设置
copy.tagline_en: Deploy web apps to Vercel and manage domains and env vars
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly deploy websites to Vercel and manage their settings.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 Vercel 命令行部署网站,并在发链接前先检查本地构建是否通过、部署是否成功、线上地址能否正常访问。
howto.when: 当用户要求部署、发布 Web 应用,或管理 Vercel 项目、域名、环境变量时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个项目部署到 Vercel 生产环境。
say.note: 会执行生产部署并验证发布链接。

say.text: 把当前目录部署到 Vercel 预览环境。
say.note: 生成非生产环境的预览链接。

say.text: 拉取 Vercel 的环境变量到本地。
say.note: 会执行 env pull 并写入本地 .env。

howto.what_en: When enabled, Claude uses the Vercel CLI to deploy web apps, checks the local build, confirms deployment readiness, and verifies the live URL before sharing it.
howto.when_en: Triggers when asked to deploy or publish a web app, or manage Vercel projects, domains, and environment variables.

say_en.text: Deploy this project to Vercel production.
say_en.note: Runs a production deploy and verifies the URL.

say_en.text: Deploy the current directory to a preview.
Pull Vercel env vars to local.
say_en.note: Runs env pull and writes local .env.
